svg.title: The Lawnmower Sweep
svg.desc: A branded RoboLore diagram shows a Zumo robot following a lawnmower sweep pattern inside a bounded zone. Solid green paths show rows already driven, dashed paths show the remainder, and a proximity cone shows the robot stopping short at a silver ball. A simplified, small-size Zumo illustration marks the stop point. All labels and instructional overlays remain live SVG text and vectors.
svg.text: Every row ends at the wall — and every wall contact erases the drift
WALLS — containment AND landmark, zero lines of code
silver strip — the door (raw channel only)
about as long as last row
every row ends ON the wall.
Solid green = rows driven · dashed = the rest of the pattern · the amber cone is the prox’s view · Lesson 13, GRAPHIC 13.1
